app-logo.prompt: App icon logo mark for 'TripGuardian', a Da Lat trip planner. A single bold emblem: a shield that is also a location pin (rounded top shoulders, softly pointed bottom) filled with a dusk gradient from deep plum #6b3550 at the bottom to dusty rose #c97890 to soft pink #efb8c4 at the top. Inside it, in cream #fff9f8, one elegant pine tree silhouette whose center negative space is carved as a four-point compass star, with one thin curved trail line winding up from the pine's base like a path through hills, and a small cream sun dot at upper right. Flat modern vector with a subtle inner glow, very few shapes, confident geometry, distinctive and memorable, still reads clearly at 16 pixels as a favicon. Centered on a plain solid cream #fff9f8 background with generous margin. No text, no letters, no watermark, no 3D, no photo. Strict palette only: deep plum #6b3550, dusty rose #c97890, soft pink #efb8c4, warm cream #fff9f8, lake blue #4a6488, violet #6b5394.
